import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
tt=np.asarray(t,float); PP=np.asarray(P,float); yy=np.asarray(dP_dt,float)
def cols(c1,c2):
    return np.column_stack([PP**2, np.log(1+c1*tt)*np.sqrt(PP), np.exp(-c2*PP**2)*np.sqrt(tt)])
def resid(q):
    X=cols(q[0],q[1]); coef,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,yy,rcond=None)
    return yy-X@coef
best=None
for k in range(20):
    q0=rng.uniform(0.01,2,2)
    r=least_squares(resid,q0,max_nfev=500)
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
X=cols(*best.x); coef,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,yy,rcond=None)
